title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Detour Credit from Driven versus Estimated Miles
content:
**Clause.** In a late-delivery dispute on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the detour credit compares the GPS miles driven on the disputed violation's batch with the estimated route miles on its offer: driven miles of 1.5 times the estimate or more give a detour credit of 2 points; from 1.25 times the estimate up to but not including 1.5 times it give 1 point; less gives no credit.

Both figures are read from the batch record in Cartwise Shopper Batches: the GPS miles actually driven, and the estimated route miles shown on the batch's offer.

| Driven miles compared with the estimate | Detour credit |
|---|---|
| 1.5 times the estimate or more | 2 points |
| 1.25 times up to, not including, 1.5 times | 1 point |
| Under 1.25 times | None |

## Worked readings (hypothetical batch with an 8.0-mile estimate)

1.5 times 8.0 miles is 12.0 miles; 1.25 times 8.0 miles is 10.0 miles.

| Miles driven | Credit |
|---|---|
| 12.0 | 2 points |
| 11.9 | 1 point |
| 10.0 | 1 point |
| 9.9 | None |
